pin_title: 6 Backyard Bonfire Night Party Ideas UK Hosts Love This Year
pin_title_alt: 3 Ways to Turn Your Garden Into a Glowing Bonfire Night Hangout
pin_hook: Skip the crowds - host a cosy fireside night at home
pin_description: Hosting Bonfire Night at home this year? These well-reviewed garden party ideas help you set up a cosy backyard bonfire: a cast iron fire pit bowl, warm festoon lights, a chunky knitted throw, enamel mugs for hot chocolate and flameless outdoor candles. Easy garden lighting and fire pit ideas for 5th November. #ad #bonfirenight #firepit #gardenideas #ukdeals
intro: Fancy skipping the packed display this year? Here's everything you need to host a warm, glowing Bonfire Night in your own back garden.

products.why: A big, sturdy cast iron fire bowl that gives everyone somewhere to gather and warm up. It's a buy that keeps earning its place on chilly evenings long after 5th November.

products.name: GPATIO 30m Mains Powered Outdoor Festoon Lights
